issues.title: Reduce complexity - participant-states.ts
issues.body:
I wish us to reduce some complex methods.

participant-states.ts contains a complex method.

I'd like these methods to be refactored into smaller modular units. I'd like these smaller methods to be covered by unit testing.

comments.body: Re-open:  @IanMayo to investigate re-writing some of the code with simpler logic.
